title: Butternut Squash Soup
description: A silky, slightly sweet squash soup simmered with red pepper, onion and garlic, then blended and finished with cream and fresh thyme.

ingredients.note: peeled and cubed (about 8 cups; pre-cut is fine)
plus a little extra for serving

steps.heading: Simmer
steps.text: Put the squash, pepper, onion, garlic, 5 cups of water, the salt and the sugar in a large pot. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer gently about 35 minutes, until the squash is very soft.

steps.heading: Blend
steps.text: Purée with a stick blender until smooth. With a countertop blender, work in batches and leave the lid's vent open so the steam can escape.

steps.heading: Add the Cream
steps.text: Stir in the cream and bring the soup back to a gentle simmer.

steps.heading: Season
steps.text: Stir in the thyme (or curry powder), then taste and add more salt if needed.

steps.heading: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls and swirl a little extra cream on top.
